blocks.tamil_translation: Qiyamah, will be in a very low position. The fourth kind of person: Allah Ta'ala has given him neither wealth nor knowledge of the Deen. He wishes, “If I had wealth, I too would have spent it wastefully like so-and-so (like the third kind of person)!' He will be punished because of his evil intention. And he and the third kind of person are equal in sin. (That is, just as there is a reward for a good deed, there is a reward for a good intention, and just as there is a punishment for an evil deed, there is a punishment for an evil intention.)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ اَهْلِ الْمَدِيْنَةِ قَالَ: كَتَبَ مُعَاوِيَةُ ﵁ اِلَي عَائِشَةَ ﵂ اَنِ اكْتُبِيْ اِلَيَّ كِتَاباً تُوْصِيْنِيْ فِيْهِ وَلَا تُكْثِرِيْ عَلَيَّ، قَالَ: فَكَتَبَتْ عَائِشَةُ ﵂ اِلَي مُعَاوِيَةَ ﵁: سَلَامٌ عَلَيْكَ اَمَّا بَعْدُ فَاِنِّيْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُوْلُ: «مَنِ الْتَمَسَ رِضَا اللهِ بِسَخَطِ النَّاسِ كَفَاهُ اللهُ مُؤْنَةَ النَّاسِ، وَمَنِ الْتَمَسَ رِضَا النَّاسِ بِسَخَطِ اللهِ وَكَلَهُ اللهُ اِلَي النَّاسِ» وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي، باب منه عاقبة من التمس رضا الناس...، رقم:٢٤١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: A man from Madinah Munawwarah says, “Hazrat Mu'awiyah (RA) wrote a letter to Hazrat Aishah (RA) asking her to write and send him some advice, and that it should be brief. After praising Allah and writing Salawat and Salam upon the Prophet ﷺ, Hazrat Aishah (RA) (wrote), “If someone is engaged in seeking the pleasure of Allah Ta'ala without caring about the displeasure of people, Allah Ta'ala becomes sufficient for him to protect him from the harm of the people's displeasure.
